gloss: to blow through; to pass through (of wind)

definitions.gloss: to blow through; to blow past; to sweep through
definitions.explanation: For wind or air to pass through an open space, tunnel, corridor, or similar passage.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}が{廊下|ろうか}を{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: The wind blew through the hallway.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}を{開|あ}けると{気持|きも}ちのいい{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: When I opened the window, a pleasant breeze blew through.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}からの{強|つよ}い{風|かぜ}が{街|まち}を{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}けて、{木|き}の{葉|は}が{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: A strong wind from the sea swept through the town, sending leaves flying.

notes:
{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける is an intransitive ichidan verb, a compound of {吹|ふ}く (to blow) and {抜|ぬ}ける (to pass through).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pattern: {風|かぜ}が〜を{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける (the wind blows through)
- {吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける{風|かぜ} (wind blowing through)
- {谷|たに}を{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける (to blow through a valley)

RELATED WORDS:
- {吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}け: an atrium or open space spanning multiple floors in a building — derived from the same concept of air flowing through an open space
